scope: full repo: *.py, *.json, *.jsonl, *.md — runtime, planner, tests, docs, checkpoints, registry, summaries, migration artifacts
method: pattern sweep over 12 known superseded-knowledge classes + manual verification of each hit against current authoritative artifacts (artifact_registry.json, home_policy.py operator-policy comments, GATES.md, migration distilled/ + zcode audits, run traces)
classification_rule: A historical raw trace containing an old conclusion is NOT pollution. Pollution = a derived/current/runtime-path artifact still treating the superseded statement as authoritative.

findings.stale_statement: After S3 40k/50k milestones: `if observation.stamina_adequate: VOCAL else REST ('season_3_stamina_low_rest')` — low stamina directly forces REST at the base-decision level.
findings.current_authoritative_replacement: Operator policy 2026-09-05 (recorded in home_policy.py lines 12-18 and artifact_registry.json runtime_patch_20260905): LOW_STAMINA is WARNING_ONLY — it never by itself forces REST; it only makes the fresh failure-rate read mandatory. VOCAL authority = fresh failure rate (VOCAL_FAILURE_RATE_GATE: >2 → REST, <=2 → VOCAL allowed), implemented in apply_vocal_risk_guard(). The S3 base branch bypasses apply_vocal_risk_guard by returning REST before the guard runs, contradicting the module's own comment (lines 13-15: 'must never by itself force REST').
findings.runtime_reachable: yes — decide_home() is called from main.py:563/683/895; the season==3 branch executes on any fresh S3 HOME decision
findings.test_impact: test_home_policy.py:52-60 (test_season_three_completed_milestones_stamina_policy) pins the stale behavior — see F-02
findings.recommended_action: Change the S3 base branch to return VOCAL for milestone-complete S3 regardless of stamina_adequate and let apply_vocal_risk_guard own the stamina/failure-rate semantics; update F-02 test in the same change. Smallest-evidence change; do NOT touch S1/S2 branches or the guard.

findings.stale_statement: Asserts decide_home(HomeObservation(3,3,0,...,stamina_adequate=False)) == ('REST', 'season_3_stamina_low_rest') — encodes the superseded 'low stamina → REST' hard rule as expected behavior.
findings.current_authoritative_replacement: Operator authoritative rule: low stamina is warning-only; with a fresh failure rate <=2 VOCAL is allowed even at low stamina (cf. test_wing_fast_handlers.py case1-5 which encode the CURRENT semantics correctly).
findings.test_impact: This test will fail when F-01 is fixed; it is the contamination vector that makes the stale rule look 'verified'. Must be updated together with F-01.
findings.recommended_action: Rewrite the test to assert the guard semantics: S3 milestone-complete + low fresh stamina + no failure read → NEED_MORE_OBSERVATION/LOW_STAMINA_WARNING path; + failure rate 0-2 → VOCAL; >2 → REST.
